title: The Visual Masterpiece
body: I often enjoy having a visual cue to my KPIs and this is the best option I’ve found for my habit formation. The done tabs when they stack overtime becomes a motivation.
author: ashane w.

title: Great app!
body: Simple in execution but quite effective

title: Incredible
body: Great UI, native dark mode, and some nifty settings to manage all the habits gets this a +1. The 2 habit cap is actually well thought out. It stops me from overdoing the habits in light of motivation XD
author: SS🔆
